newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - JP Morgan cuts four wireless cos. [CORRECTED 16:22 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - JP Morgan cuts four wireless cos. [CORRECTED 16:22 GMT]

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan analyst Kurt Abkemeier (corrects from Scott Renzulli) said in a research note that he lowered recommendations on four wireless communications companies "because of concerns about the long-term effect of PCS (personal communications services) and high debt levels ... "

-- In his note, Abkemeier said he cut Paging Network Inc to market perform from buy, Mobile Telecommunication Technologies Corp to market performer from long-term buy, PageMart Wireless Inc to long-term buy from buy and Arch Communications Group Inc to market perfrom from buy.

"Although we do not think that broadband PCS will obsolesce paging entirely, we are concerned that over the long-term, broadband PCS may render paging less attractive versus cellular and PCS. Also, since paging companies are generally higher leveraged, their returns should be specifically influenced by their debt burden," the analyst said.
-- In early Nasdaq trade, Paging Network slipped 1/8 to 13-1/2, Mobile Telecommunication added 1/4 to 6-1/2, PageMart was up 1/4 to seven and Arch was off 1/8 to 7-3/4.
